subject: ClinicPlus — confirmation of no-adaptive-learning commitment & operational evidence
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@clinicplus.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@clinicplus.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: ClinicPlus - confirmation of no-adaptive-learning + evidence request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal and Compliance have one outstanding ask before procurement can sign the DPA redline: we need a firm, operational confirmation that ClinicPlus data will not be used to improve or adapt Redwood models (no-adaptive-learning / no-train).

Specifically, Compliance wants:
- A one-paragraph commitment to include in the DPA (we can incorporate into our redline).
- A short evidence pack describing how you prevent model updates from tenant data (KV handling, telemetry filters, sampling policies).
- Export options for logs/outputs (SFTP vs API) and confirmation of retention windows.

I've attached our current DPA redline for reference and included Compliance on the thread.

Can you confirm timing for delivery (we're trying to close by EOW this week)?

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Security & Privacy
ClinicPlus Health

Attachments: ClinicPlus_DPA_Redline_v1.docx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@clinicplus.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ClinicPlus - confirmation of no-adaptive-learning + evidence request

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front:
1) Commitment: Redwood provides a tenant-level no-adaptive-learning commitment for enterprise customers in our DPA and operational controls; we will not use ClinicPlus input data to update or fine-tune any public or internal model variants unless you opt-in via a signed addendum.

2) Evidence pack: we'll share an operations packet that includes:
   • architecture sketch showing inference-only paths and where KV cache is ephemeral,
   • logging filters (what telemetry is collected + sampling thresholds),
   • the standard SFTP export flow and retention policy, and
   • a signed attestation template for SOC/contracting purposes.

3) Export/retention: SFTP export is available; we will also provide API export options. Default retention for prompt/response payloads in enterprise tenants is 30 days unless an alternate retention is agreed in the DPA.

Next steps: David (ops) will assemble the evidence artifacts; Marissa (sales) will update the HubSpot deal and coordinate procurement language. We can deliver a first-pass evidence bundle + DPA clause text by today 16:00 PT and a formal attestation by EOD tomorrow.

I'll attach the clause we recommend using in the DPA.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Privacy & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_no-adaptive-learning_clause.txt
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@clinicplus.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@clinicplus.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ClinicPlus - confirmation of no-adaptive-learning + evidence request

Rachel —

Thanks, that is helpful. Quick follow-ups from Compliance:
- Can the evidence pack include a simple diagram that shows where prompt/response copies are stored (if at all) and how ephemeral KV caches are purged?
- Will you sign a clause that includes an explicit sentence: "Redwood will not use Customer Content to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve models without Customer's prior written consent" — Compliance prefers explicit language.
- Procurement needs the attestation in signed PDF form for our files.

If you can include those items in the deliverable today, Procurement can proceed with the purchase order. Otherwise we may need a short call to expedite.

Daniel

>

Date: 2026-12-08T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ClinicPlus - confirmation of no-adaptive-learning + evidence request

Daniel —

We're attaching the first-pass evidence bundle inline and have uploaded the attestation PDF to the shared link. Highlights:
- Diagram: included (evidence_kv_cache_diagram.png) shows inference-only path, ephemeral KV cache lifecycle and the point at which telemetry is scrubbed.
- Clause language: below is the recommended DPA insertion that legal has validated — happy to put it into a DocuSign if that expedites procurement:

  "Model Improvement and Customer Data: Redwood Inference will not use Customer Content to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve any model or model weights without the Customer's prior written consent. Customer Content may be processed for the sole purpose of providing the Services (inference), and ephemeral caches will be purged according to the retention schedule set forth in this Agreement."

- Attestation: signed PDF uploaded to the HubSpot deal and downloadable here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234/deal/CLP-4921 (see paperwork tab).

Timeline: we delivered the bundle at 13:15 PT and can do a 30-minute call at 15:00 PT today if Compliance wants to go through the artifacts live. If all looks good, Marissa will send the final PO instructions and we can update the DPA with the insertion text and countersign.

Thanks — looping LexCorp Legal so they see the clause.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Head of Privacy & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
